text:
Alex: Heads up — we're finalizing the handoff for the new ap-south2 GPU cluster (32xA100 pool) tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need SRE ownership, pager rules, and a short oncall training run. :rocket:

Maria: Thanks — what's the proposed escalation path?

Alex: High-level: sev0 -> phone + PD incident -> ENG infra escalate. Sev1 -> PD page + SRE primary. Sev2 -> slack-only + SRE async. Will paste pagerduty rules in a sec.

Devon: Can we get the runbook link and the smoke validation steps? I want to cross-check with infra runbook.

Alex: Runbook (draft): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ap-south2-gpu-provisioning (please treat as draft). Key checks: node readiness, GPU driver + MIG, nvlink health, kube autoscaler, network egress rules, AZ distribution, cost caps.

Ryan: For paging, suggest we only page on metrics tied to capacity and latency: GPU allocation failure rate > 2% over 5m, scheduler pending pods > 10 for 5m, pod eviction loops, and node kernel panics.

Sam: +1. Also page on unexpected host reboots and node-not-ready > 3m. We should suppress noisy pod-level alerts during node upgrades.

Alex: Agreed. Draft PD rule (copy to new service):

```yaml
service: ap-south2-gpu
escalation_policy: SRE-team
alerts:
  - name: gpu-allocation-failure
    condition: rate(gpu_alloc_fail[5m]) > 0.02
    urgency: high
  - name: node-not-ready
    condition: increase(kube_node_status_condition{condition=\"Ready\",status=\"false\"}[3m]) > 0
    urgency: high
  - name: pending-gpu-pods
    condition: count(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=\"Pending\",label_gpu=\"true\"}) > 10
    urgency: low
```

Maria: Can you add a cost guard alert? e.g., daily spend spike > 30% vs baseline and reserved-capacity burn rate. We want ops visibility before budget surprises.

Alex: Added a cost alert to the runbook and billing dashboards.

Devon: Training logistics: propose a 30-minute readout + hands-on oncall drill at 09:00 PT tomorrow right after handoff. We'll simulate a gpu-allocation-failure alert and walk responders through runbook steps. Who can lead?

Sam: I can lead the drill. Will prepare a checklist and a short slide deck.

Ryan: For validation, here's the smoke checklist I used before:
1) kubectl get nodes -o wide -> ensure all GPU nodes Ready and labels present
2) run nvidia-smi inside a test pod, verify all cards visible
3) run small perf job (50 tokens) across 4 nodes to exercise scheduler
4) verify KV cache warmup and prefix cache behavior on the runtime
5) confirm egress to model artifact storage (S3) and KMS access

Devon: Add step to verify autoscaler is respecting reserved capacity and not scaling below our committed pool.

Alex: We'll also run a PD alert test: create a synthetic alert for gpu-allocation-failure and follow full escalation to ensure phones and rotation are correct.

oncall-bot: rotation update: Sam assigned as primary SRE for ap-south2 for the first 7 days post-handoff. Backup: Ryan.

Maria: What's the fallback if the region has provider capacity issues? Do we fail-over to eu-west3/dedicated?

Alex: Fallback plan: automatic region routing disabled for first 48h. If provider capacity issue detected, operator-run migration to eu-west3 dedicated pool with DNS routing changes. We'll document steps in the runbook and pre-create firewall/peering.

Sam: I'll add the PD runbook section with exact phone numbers, Slack escalation matrix, and a checklist:
- Acknowledge PD incident
- Run smoke checks (Ryan list)
- Check GPU driver/kernel logs: /var/log/nvidia-driver.log and dmesg for OOM or GPU reset
- If node hardware suspected, mark node unschedulable and drain
- If broader cluster: open infra war room and escalate to infra leads

Devon: Also add a small command snippet for quick health dump:

```bash
kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-ap-south2 -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, ready: .status.conditions[] | select(.type=="Ready") .status, gpu: .status.allocatable["nvidia.com/gpu"]}'
kubectl logs -n gpu-system -l app=gpu-runtime --tail=200
```

Alex: Good. Last items: PD service created, infra has pre-provisioned SSH jumpboxes, and billing alert wired. Sam, please post the final runbook to the runbooks page and ping this thread when done.

Sam: Will do. Final prep meeting scheduled for 08:30 PT tomorrow. 30m drill at 09:00 PT. I'll drop calendar invites.

Maria: LGTM. Thanks everyone — let's keep the handoff crisp. :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks — tagging @oncall to make sure rotations are visible.

oncall-bot: test alert acknowledged: synthetic gpu-allocation-failure triggered by Alex at 1765554400. PD incident created and resolved (test).

Sam: Posted final runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ap-south2-gpu-provisioning/final and calendar invites sent. See you tomorrow.

Ryan: I'll be on standby for the drill.

Devon: Great work, ship it.
